name: Wayscom Datacenter Cayenne
notes: Wayscom official page describes a cloud datacenter operational in Cayenne, French Guiana, with colocation, hosting, redundant power and precision cooling; DataCenterMap lists the facility at 513 Zone Industrielle Collery 5, 97300 Cayenne. No MW capacity found.

name: Guyane Numerique backbone and hosting data centers
notes: Guyane Numerique official network map states 2 data centers for backbone and hosting services and describes the operator's delegated public-service telecom infrastructure. Inflect lists a Guyane Numerique Cayenne data center at 25 Lotissement Marengo, Cayenne. Treat as an operating local/telecom data-center asset; exact split/location of the two official data centers was not confirmed from public sources.

name: Saint-Laurent-du-Maroni digital data-storage infrastructure
notes: Official PLU/PADD planning document for Saint-Laurent-du-Maroni lists digital priorities including household fiber, public Wi-Fi spaces and 'infrastructures de stockage des donnees numeriques (data center)'. No named operator, site, MW capacity, or construction evidence found; recorded as a weak planned municipal digital-infrastructure project rather than a confirmed commercial data center.
